Replays archive fragments with timing delays and forwards shred and repair output.

# Purpose
`fd_tile_archiver_playback` defines a tile that reads archived network fragments from an archive file and replays them into the live tile graph with timing taken from the capture. It is a tile implementation for the `fd_stem` runtime, not a standalone program. The file sets the tile footprint, scratch layout, allowed file descriptors, and seccomp policy, then creates and initializes the tile context in [`privileged_init`](<#privileged_init>) and [`unprivileged_init`](<#unprivileged_init>).

The main runtime logic is in [`after_credit`](<#after_credit>), where the tile waits for the replay system to start, checks the stored fragment timing, reads each archived fragment header and payload, and publishes the fragment to the correct output link. The code supports only the `shred` and `repair` tile targets, tracks playback state and fragment counts, and stops when the archive stream ends or when it sees an invalid header.
